# Kai Hohonu — Hawaiian Spearfishing (Roblox)

A freediving / spearfishing progression game set on a Hawaiian reef.
Start with your uncle's bamboo pole spear and a 25-second breath hold;
work your way to spearguns, carbon fins, boats and the blue-water
pelagics — 'ahi, ono, and the mythic kajiki (blue marlin).

**The entire map is generated by code at server start** (terrain island,
reef, coral, dock, NPCs, FAD buoy), so the game runs from a bare Rojo
build with no place file or assets required.

## Getting it into Roblox Studio

The project uses [Rojo](https://rojo.space):

```bash
# install rojo (via aftman, cargo, or the VS Code extension)
aftman install          # reads aftman.toml in this folder

# option A — live sync into an open Studio place
rojo serve              # then "Connect" from the Rojo plugin in Studio

# option B — build a place file and open it
rojo build -o KaiHohonu.rbxlx
```

Press **Play** in Studio. The island, reef, and fish spawn automatically.

> DataStores (saving) need a published place with *Enable Studio Access
> to API Services* checked, or play in a live server. In a plain Studio
> test the game still works — progress just isn't persisted.

## How to play

| Input | Action |
|---|---|
| Hold **left click** (or the 🔱 touch button) | Charge your spear — more charge = more range & catch chance |
| Release | Fire |
| **B** | Catch bag & Fishdex |
| Swim down | Your breath drains faster the deeper you go |
| **E** at an NPC | Open their shop |

- **Uncle Kimo (Fish Market)** — sell your catch, market quest line.
- **Leilani (Dive Shop)** — spears, fins, bags, dive lights; breath
  training and invasive-species culling quests (roi, ta'ape, to'au).
- **Kainoa (Boat Dock)** — boats, deep-water quest line. Boats are
  drivable (sit in the seat, throttle with W/S, steer with A/D) and the
  cruiser/sportfisher let you sell your catch at sea.

## Core loops

1. **Dive → spear → sell → upgrade.** Fish value scales with species
   rarity and rolled size. Golden variants (1/200) are worth 6x and get
   server-wide announcements, as do trophy-size fish.
2. **Dive to train.** Every second underwater earns lung XP (more when
   deep). Max breath grows from 25s to 125s across 50 slow levels
   (~19 hours of cumulative dive time to max).
3. **Go further out.** Shallow reef → outer reef → the drop-off →
   offshore FAD buoy. Each zone has better fish; boats make the far
   zones practical.
4. **Collect.** 28 real Hawaiian species in the Fishdex with best-size
   records; three quest lines with unlock rewards (Kaimana fins,
   railgun, sportfisher).

See `GAME_DESIGN.md` for tuning details, the economy curve, and the
post-launch roadmap (monetization, social features).

## Code layout

```
src/shared/   GameConfig, FishData, GearData, QuestData, Remotes, Util
src/server/   init (bootstrap), MapBuilder (procedural island),
              FishService (spawning + AI), SpearService (catch rolls),
              BreathService (freediving + lung XP), EconomyService,
              QuestService, BoatService, DataService (DataStore)
src/client/   init, HUD, SpearController, ShopUI, BagUI, QuestTracker,
              FishBillboards, UIKit
```

Everything server-side is authoritative: the client only sends an aim
ray + charge; hits, catch rolls, cooldowns, breath, money and purchases
are all validated on the server.
